# TurfMate Changelog Skill

Maintain `docs/CHANGELOG.md`.

For every meaningful completed change add:

## Date

YYYY-MM-DD

## Change

Short description.

## Added

New functionality.

## Changed

Modified behavior.

## Fixed

Bug fixes.

## Database

Schema/migration changes.

## API

API changes.

## Testing

Tests executed.

## Status

COMPLETE / PARTIAL / BLOCKED

Never add changes that were not actually implemented.
